description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git reflog expire' functionality within the Git version control system. It contains test cases, utility functions, and setup routines to validate reflog expiration, listing, deletion, handling of edge cases, and configuration impacts.

methods.name: check_have
methods.description: Checks if specified objects exist in the repository by trying to read their type with 'git cat-file -t'.

methods.name: check_fsck
methods.description: Runs 'git fsck --full' to verify repository consistency, optionally grepping for a specific message.

methods.name: corrupt
methods.description: Simulates corruption by moving object files out of the objects directory.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Restores a corrupted object back into the repository objects directory.
